# Licence note for nrLDPC_decoder_fast

* The sources in `upstream/` (decoder, kernels, tests, the table generator) were written from scratch for this project
  (noro-leg/OAI_for_ARM, "dec_std"); they contain no code copied from OAI, srsRAN or any other project.
* `upstream/tables/ldpc_tables.c` is generated by `upstream/tables/gen_tables.py` from the base-graph tables of
  3GPP TS 38.212 (Tables 5.3.2-1/-2/-3). srsRAN_Project and OAI's `nrLDPC_lut.h` were only *read* by the generator to
  cross-check the extracted values (no content of them is emitted).
* The code is contributed to this OAI tree under the licence of the surrounding files
  (`SPDX-License-Identifier: LicenseRef-CSSL-1.0`, see `LICENSE` and `LICENSES/` at the top of the repository). The
  vendored files are kept byte-identical to their upstream (except `patches/`) and therefore carry no SPDX header of
  their own; this note applies to every file below this directory.
* Before submitting this directory to the OpenAirInterface Software Alliance, the copyright holder must confirm the
  licence grant (OSA contributor agreement).
